title: Schedule
description: One recurring run. POSIX cron plus an IANA timezone.

cron.description: Standard POSIX cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.

timezone.description: IANA identifier. Cron matches literal wall-clock time, so avoid 01:00-03:00 local where a missed or duplicated run on a DST boundary would matter.

prompt.description: The user turn that opens the run. Required: the deploy API's initial_events needs a user.message, and a scheduled run has no human at a keyboard to supply one.
